messages:
alex.p: Quick sync — I'm drafting delivery checkpoints for the on‑prem distro (VPC + air‑gapped flavors). Need netops, runtime, and sales input on launch gates and minimal upgrade guarantees. Posting a sketch below.

maria.g: Thanks. What's our target for 'no‑impact' upgrades? several customers asked for near‑zero downtime for patch releases.

sam.sre: For minor patches we can do rolling upgrades with node drain + KV-cache warming. Real 'zero' is hard if customers pin ports/IPs, but aim for <5m interruption for control plane says @sam.sre.

kai.ux: UX question: do we ship a single offline bundle or per‑customer image manifests? offline bundle is simpler for field but increases support surface.

nick.sales: Major customers (finance) need IP preservation and deterministic port mapping. Also an installer mode that preserves existing NAT rules — they won't tolerate reassigning IP ranges.

alex.p: Draft checkpoints (high level):
```
- Preflight: disk, kernel modules, iptables rules, cert chain sanity
- Networking contract: preserve static IPs, annotate required ports, explicit NAT/pass‑through policy
- Upgrade lanes: minor=rolling (no DB schema change), major=blue/green or staged tenant drain
- Canary: 1–2 tenants on dedicated subnet -> monitor 24h -> escalate/fallback
- Fallback: automated image rollback + route revert + cert rollback
- Audit & logs: minimal telemetry during airgap, signed manifests for offline installs
```

maria.g: Agree with lanes. Note: rolling minor needs migration shim for KV cache invalidation. I'll propose a lightweight migration API to coordinate drains.

sam.sre: +1. Also add a readiness probe for runtime that gates traffic shifting. We should allow configurable drain timeout per customer.

kai.ux: For the offline UX, propose a guided CLI with these flags: `--preserve-ips`, `--manifest-signature`, `--dry-run`. Keeps support calls down.

nick.sales: Can we make `--preserve-ips` a default for enterprise SKU? That will help field adoption.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] created file: /rfc/onprem-delivery-checkpoints/draft-v1.md

alex.p: Good notes. Action items: Maria to draft migration API surface; Sam to write readiness probe contract; Kai to mock CLI flows; Nick to validate with 2 tier‑1 customers this week. I'll convert to a PR by EOD and link RFC. :thumbsup:

maria.g: on it.

sam.sre: I'll drop a probe sketch in the PR.

kai.ux: Will mock flows and share screen Friday.

nick.sales: I'll ping Acme & Tradeworks for constraints and report back Monday.

alex.p: If anyone has edge cases (multi‑NIC, overlapping CIDRs, 3rd‑party LB), post them here before I cut the PR.

sam.sre: Edge case: tenant burst IPs (ephemeral ext IPs). Need explicit recommendation to preserve ephemeral allocations or map them behind NAT.

maria.g: Edge case: air‑gapped cert rotation — include offline key escrow steps.

alex.p: Perfect. I'll fold these into the checklist. Thanks all.
